integrity: Proved by all-dimensional tensor inequality and moment formula; stochastic tests corroborative only; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the one-parameter quartic harmonic in dimensions d>=4. Volume formula specifies second order, not all polynomial coefficients. General historical-priority uncertainty remains.
title: Sharp all-dimensional convexity interval and curvature-rank loci of hyperoctahedral quartic support bodies
